        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"

      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "An unauthorized bus write can clear the enable bit, suppress generated SPI clock activity, clear queued data, and disable transfers.",

        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [
        "bus_rsp_o.data",
        "clkgen_en_o"

        383

    },

      "Information": "The prescaler, divider, and high-speed settings determine the rate at which SPI transfer steps are paced. SPI communication depends on the generated rate and its relation to the peer device.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "no",
        "Integrity": "yes",
        "Availability": "yes",
        "Undermined Expected Behavior": "no"

      "Rubric Reason": "Unchecked bus writes change the stored rate settings at lines 143 through 145, threatening configuration integrity. The settings control clock-enable generation at lines 371 through 376, so an attacker can make transfers stall or run at an unusable rate.",
      "Objectives At Risk": [
        "I",
        "A"
      ],
      "Attack": "An unauthorized bus write can select an unsuitable prescaler, divider, or high-speed mode and thereby corrupt or block SPI transfers.",
      "Enters Through": [
        "bus_req_i.data"
      ],
      "Leaves Through": [
        "bus_rsp_o.data"
      ],

      "Unit": "neorv32_spi",
      "Information": "Bytes written by the bus are transmitted serially through spi_dat_o. Outgoing transaction data depends on this payload.",
      "Rubric": {
        "Confidentiality": "yes",

      "Unit": "neorv32_spi",

        "A"

    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "FIFO occupancy and buffer status",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_spi",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The FIFO availability, free, half, and full indications at lines 160 through 163 and 231 through 240 only report or control buffered transfer data, so the buffer and engine status rules cover them under the associated data or interrupt behavior."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Transceiver sequencing state",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_spi",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The state, bit counter, busy indication, and done pulse at lines 270 through 340 only order and terminate serial-transfer steps, so the sequencing-state rule excludes them as information of their own."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Clock-enable pacing pulse and divider count",

      "Merged Into": "",

    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Serial input synchronizer stage",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_spi",
      "Merged Into": "C4",
      "Why Not Kept": ""
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Serial clock and reset signals",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_spi",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "clk_i, rstn_i, and the serial clock line are excluded by the clock, reset, and serial-link clock rules, and they do not constitute separate conceptual information in this unit."
    }
  ],
  "Notes": []
}
